create_subsets: create ~100B token subsets from source datasets like dclm, fineweb, and finepdfs using slurm jobs
create_mixtures: create 50-30-20 token mixtures from existing 100B subsets with slurm dependency chaining
shuffle_datasets: shuffle all subset and mixture datasets in memory and re-upload with shuffled suffix
run_smol_data_subsets: run the smol_data script with the subsets argument to create individual ~100B token subsets
run_smol_data_mixtures: run the smol_data script with the mixtures argument to create 50-30-20 mixture datasets
